attempts.text:
**The window starts in a persistent run.** Columns 0 to 27 are spine, carried by 91 to 100% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 0 to 7% of calls. The model names 85 to 99.6% of genes there, fewest at `hemW`, and hesitates most at `yqgD`, 0.83 bits.

**A first fork follows.** Columns 28 and 29 carry `cmtB` and `cmtA`, [[mannitol transport]], with a second family in 20 and 32% of chromosomes. The model names 88 to 89% of calls, and column 29 is its most hesitant here, 0.66 bits.

**Then a spine of 10 columns**, in 90 to 95% of chromosomes, in a region of plasticity in 6 to 32% of calls. The model names 90 to 97%, fewest at `yggP`. Columns 40 to 44 are fork and variable columns, in a region of plasticity in 60 to 65% of calls, yet named in 94 to 96%.

**A single spine column, 45, `argP`**, sits in a region of plasticity in 64% of calls, the most of any spine column. Columns 47 to 59 are spine again, in 94 to 96% of chromosomes, named 72 to 95%, fewest at `ubiI`. Column 60 is variable, `ygfF` in 53% of chromosomes.

**The window closes in fork and variable columns.** Columns 61 to 67 are spine, in a region of plasticity in 3 to 6% of calls. Columns 68 to 79 are fork and variable, in a region of plasticity in 4 to 83%, named 89 to 97%, fewest at column 79, `ghxQ`, carried by 40% of chromosomes. Inside a region of plasticity the model hesitates more than outside, 0.69 against 0.18 bits, and names fewer genes, 85% against 96%.

label: yggX
facts:
WINDOW: the yggX window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor yggX, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 771 to 850 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying yggX once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 94% of genes, 0.28 bits on average (perplexity 1.4 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 35,114 calls, named 97%, 0.16 bits; shell 7,713 calls, named 80%, 0.74 bits; cloud 213 calls, named 3%, 5.05 bits. Outside an RGP 34,601 calls, named 96%, 0.18 bits; inside an RGP 8,439 calls, named 85%, 0.69 bits. Columns: 59 spine, 4 fork, 17 variable.
COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (0.69 against 0.18 bits) and names fewer genes (85% against 96%); 8,439 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 21 (yqgD) 0.83 bits, RGP 4%; column 7 (hemW) 0.76 bits, RGP 6%; column 29 (cmtA) 0.66 bits, RGP 7%. The 14 columns where most calls are in an RGP: named 93%, 0.36 bits on average; the other 66 columns: named 94%, 0.27 bits.
PLASTICITY: the stretch most in regions of plasticity: column 45 (spine), RGP 64%; the least: columns 61-67 (spine), RGP 3-6%.
STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
1. columns 0-27 (28 columns) spine: share 91-100%, all P, RGP 0-7%. Genes: yggX "oxidative damage protection protein", mutY, trmB, yggL "YggL family protein", yggN "DUF2884 domain-containing protein", ansB, yggM "DUF1202 domain-containing protein", hemW, rdgB, yggU "DUF167 family protein YggU", yggT "YggT family protein", yggS "pyridoxal phosphate homeostasis pro…", yggR "PilT/PilU family type 4a pilus ATPa…", ruvX, yqgE "YqgE/AlgH family protein", gshB, rsmE, endA, yggI "SprT family zinc-dependent metallop…", galP, metK, yqgD "protein YqgD", yqgG "protein YqgG", yqgB "acid stress response protein YqgB", speA, speB "agmatinase", loiP, tkt. named 85-99.6% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 7 (hemW), named 85%; most hesitant at column 21 (yqgD), 0.83 bits.
2. columns 28-29 (2 columns) fork: RGP 6-7%. named 88-89% (mean 88%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 29, named 88%, 0.66 bits.
   28: cmtB P 89%; also "IS1-like element transposase" S 20%
   29: cmtA P 89% "PTS mannitol transporter subunit II…"; also "prohibitin family protein" S 32%
3. columns 30-39 (10 columns) spine: share 90-95%, all P, RGP 6-32%. Genes: yggP "zinc-binding dehydrogenase", glpX, fumE, yggC "nucleoside triphosphate hydrolase", epd, pgk, fbaA, mscS, argO, yggE "oxidative stress defense protein". named 90-97% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 30 (yggP), named 90%, 0.46 bits.
4. columns 40-44 (5 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 60-65%. named 94-96% (mean 95%), fewest named at column 43, named 94%; most hesitant at column 41, 0.35 bits.
   40 fork: srsR S 88%; also "PPC domain-containing DNA-binding prote…" S 28%
   41 variable: scpC S 84% "acetyl-CoA hydrolase/transferase C-…"
   42 variable: scpB S 83%
   43 variable: meaB S 80%
   44 variable: scpA S 80%
5. column 45 spine: share 95%, all P, RGP 64%. Genes: argP. named 94%; 0.25 bits.
6. column 46 variable: RGP 58%. named 93%; 0.43 bits.
   46: "hypothetical protein" S 72%
7. columns 47-59 (13 columns) spine: share 94-96%, all P, RGP 7-32%. Genes: rpiA, serA, ibsC, fau, zapA, ygfB "UPF0149 family protein YgfB", pepP, ubiH "FAD-dependent monooxygenase", ubiI, "hypothetical protein", gcvT "glycine cleavage T C-terminal barre…", gcvH, gcvP. named 72-95% (mean 90%), fewest named at column 55 (ubiI), named 72%; most hesitant at column 59 (gcvP), 0.37 bits.
8. column 60 variable: RGP 6%. named 91%; 0.38 bits.
   60: ygfF S 53% "SDR family NAD(P)-dependent oxidore…"
9. columns 61-67 (7 columns) spine: share 91-94%, all P, RGP 3-6%. Genes: bglA, yqfB "N(4)-acetylcytidine aminohydrolase", trhA, ygfZ "tRNA-modifying protein YgfZ", sdhE, ygfX "protein YgfX", fldB. named 92-96% (mean 94%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 61 (bglA), named 92%, 0.30 bits.
10. columns 68-79 (12 columns) fork and variable columns: RGP 4-83%. named 89-97% (mean 93%), fewest named at column 79, named 89%; most hesitant at column 77, 0.57 bits.
   columns 68-78 variable, share 50-90%, 7 P, 4 S: xerD 90%, dsbC 88%, recJ 86%, prfB 85%, lysS 82%, idi 76%, "hypothetical protein" 68%, yqfG "protein YqfG" 70%, uacT 65%, ygfT "4Fe-4S dicluster domain-containing…" 57%, ygfS "4Fe-4S binding protein" 50%
   79 fork: ghxQ P 40%; also guaD S 17%
PRODUCTS of named genes (for [[ ]]): cmtB PTS mannitol transporter subunit IIA; cmtA PTS mannitol transporter subunit IICB; scpC acetyl-CoA hydrolase/transferase C-term…; scpB enoyl-CoA hydratase-related protein; gcvH glycine cleavage system protein GcvH; gcvP aminomethyl-transferring glycine dehydr…; guaD amidohydrolase family protein
END: the window ends at column 79, ghxQ, in 40% of chromosomes.
